page_title: VEN 1-0 MON | Venezia v Monza 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Fabio Maresca is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Luca Caldirola (Monza) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
90+6' Daniel Fila (Venezia) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
90+3' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
90+2' Venezia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) goes on a mazy run, gets into the box and from around the penalty spot he misses the target. What a chance that was!
87' Monza fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
85' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Busio will be replaced by Cheick Conde (Venezia).
83' John Yeboah (Venezia) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniel Fila (Venezia) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

77' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the left side of the goal, but Stefano Turati denies him with a great save.
77' Here is a change. Kacper Urbanski is going off and Alessandro Nesta gives the last tactical orders to Omari Forson (Monza).
76' The referee signals a substitution. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
76' The substitution has been made. Tomas Palacios (Monza) has replaced Andrea Carboni.
75' Pedro Pereira (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
72' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mikael Egill Ellertsson is the provider as he slips the ball to Daniel Fila (Venezia) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:0.
71' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Kike Perez and he is replaced by Issa Doumbia (Venezia).

70' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) perfectly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate enough and the ball goes a few inches past the right post! The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
68' Luca Caldirola (Monza) has tested the patience of referee Fabio Maresca and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
65' A player from Venezia pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.

64' Ionut Radu makes a brilliant save! Dany Mota (Monza) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
62' John Yeboah (Venezia) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
61' The substitution is prepared. Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessandro Marcandalli.
61' Substitution. John Yeboah (Venezia) has come on for Gaetano Oristanio.
60' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Fila (Venezia) replacing Christian Gytkjaer.
56' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
53' Monza are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Venezia.
50' Problems for Alessandro Nesta as Armando Izzo (Monza) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Luca Caldirola replaces him.
49' Armando Izzo (Monza) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.

47' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
46' Venezia move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Kike Perez (Venezia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45+3' Decent spell from Venezia here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.
45+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The game is pretty dull as Monza are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
44' A player from Venezia commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Monza have a free kick.

42' Dany Mota (Monza) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
39' Monza fail to score from a corner as Ionut Radu (Venezia) leaps to collect the ball.
35' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
34' The referee blows his whistle as Pedro Pereira (Monza) was too aggressive in his challenge.
33' Stefano Turati (Monza) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
32' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
32' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
27' Fabio Maresca shows a yellow card to Kacper Urbanski (Monza) for his blatant foul.
26' Substitution. Keita Balde makes his way off the pitch and Gianluca Caprari (Monza) comes on as his replacement.
25' Monza couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Ionut Radu (Venezia) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
21' Monza show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman signals a throw-in for Venezia.
17' Monza hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
15' Great teamplay by Venezia as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
13' Venezia keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
11' The ball is out of play. Monza will have a throw-in.
10' Yellow card. Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
8' The free kick from long range, taken by Monza, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
4' A corner kick by Monza is thwarted by the well prepared Ionut Radu (Venezia).
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
3' The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
3' Monza are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball goes out of play and Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Venezia will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Fabio Maresca.
